# Capsules & Health Ingredients

As a global leader in capsule design, manufacturing and encapsulation technology, we are dedicated
to create customized solutions that help you deliver groundbreaking health products to the market.

Backed by an ecosystem of technological insights, world class manufacturing, scientific expertise
and process excellence, we can support your brand throughout the entire development lifecycle.

#### With over 100 years of dosage expertise, we help our customers configure a wide variety of
#### capsule solutions to meet many common applications

#### ~120 patent families including more than 40 ingredient and over 80 capsule and dosage form
#### patent families, helping brands stand out

#### 7,000+ customers around the world leverage our comprehensive products and services, enabling
#### hundreds of millions of patients and consumers to live more active, healthier lives
* About Capsules & Health Ingredients
* Highlights in our history
* Markets we serve
* Global network
* Sustainability

#### We are capsule and health ingredients experts

Powered by industry-leading technologies, science-backed ingredients and a rich history in the
pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, we are more than just our products. We are capsule
experts, ingredient scientists and manufacturers with a solutions-focused mindset and we have been
helping brands overcome challenges for more than 100 years.

We support brands with a broad range of hard empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical
industries, including clean label and plant-based alternatives, as well as innovative delivery
technologies.

In addition, we offer a range of science-backed specialty health ingredients. Fueled by
consumer-centric data, our ingredients enable brands to disrupt the nutraceutical market with
purposeful products for human and animal nutrition.

We are constantly evolving and innovating to help you deliver products that meet in-demand patient
and consumer needs, as well as key market trends. Our concept-to-market services can assist you in
designing, optimizing and manufacturing your unique dosage forms that meet evolving patient and
consumer requirements.

#### Our difference

We are the preferred partner for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies around the world.
Helping you to create purpose-led, market-disrupting products with a competitive edge requires a
deep commitment to excellence. We are dedicated to adding value to your brand at every stage of your
development process, from concept to consumer.

* 1970
  
  We introduced the most popular two-piece hard gelatin capsule in the world - Capsugel® Coni-Snap®
  Hard Gelatin Capsule. This technology is a patented, two-ring closure system facilitating
  high-speed filling processing and secure locking of capsule body and cap.
* 1985
  
  Our portfolio of premium grade L-carnitine ingredients began with the launch of Carnipure®
  L-carnitine crystalline, which accelerated research and development behind the important benefits
  of L-carnitine for human and animal health.
* 1986
  
  ChromeMate® niacin-bound chromium complex was launched, offering nutraceutical brands an
  opportunity to create science-backed solutions that help to maintain healthy cholesterol levels
  and support weight management.
* 1990
  
  Carnipure® L-carnitine tartrate was introduced into the nutraceutical market and the first human
  clinical trials were initiated, leading to groundbreaking new insights behind the role of
  L-carnitine in supporting exercise recovery.
* 1993
  
  Our journey exploring science-backed solutions to meet the needs of the pet and production animal
  markets began with the launch of Carniking® L-carnitine for pet health.
* 1997
  
  Super CitriMax® 60% HCA was launched into the nutraceutical market, offering brands a unique
  solution for satiety and appetite.
* 1998
  
  We transformed the pharmaceutical industry with the introduction of our DBCaps® over-encapsulation
  capsules. This is a double-blind solution with a tamper-evident design, addressing the clinical
  trial challenge of testing without bias.
* 2000
  
  Capsugel® Licaps® liquid-filled capsules were launched into the nutraceutical market with a
  revolutionary capsule sealing and fusion technology. This technology is specifically designed to
  encapsulate liquid-based and specialty powder formulations.
  
  In the same year, we brought our L-Optizinc® zinc mono-L-methionine sulfate ingredient to market,
  offering superior absorption, retention and antioxidant properties over other forms of zinc.
* 2001
  
  UC-II® undenatured type II collagen was launched, marking the beginning of its successful journey
  as a unique joint health ingredient, available for clinical trial investigation.
* 2008
  
  ResistAid® arabinogalactan was launched, making the unique immune health benefits of this
  ingredient available to brands in the nutraceutical market.
* 2009
  
  The gold standard in HPMC capsules was introduced — Capsugel® Vcaps® Plus HPMC capsules. This
  capsule is produced by specifically developed thermo-gelation processes, without the addition of
  gelling systems.
* 2011
  
  We introduced our DRcaps® designed release capsules. Created to protect sensitive ingredients like
  probiotics against stomach acid and release them at the right time and in the right location in
  the body, this capsule polymer allows brands to create more advanced products that target diverse
  health areas.
  
  We transformed the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical market through Plantcaps® pullulan capsules—a
  plant-based vegetarian alternative. This groundbreaking solution enables brands to meet the
  preferences of environmentally-conscious consumers and patients.

# Capsules & Health Ingredients

As a global leader in capsule design, manufacturing and encapsulation technology, we are dedicated
to create customized solutions that help you deliver groundbreaking health products to the market.

Backed by an ecosystem of technological insights, world class manufacturing, scientific expertise
and process excellence, we can support your brand throughout the entire development lifecycle.

#### With over 100 years of dosage expertise, we help our customers configure a wide variety of
#### capsule solutions to meet many common applications

#### ~120 patent families including more than 40 ingredient and over 80 capsule and dosage form
#### patent families, helping brands stand out

#### 7,000+ customers around the world leverage our comprehensive products and services, enabling
#### hundreds of millions of patients and consumers to live more active, healthier lives
* About Capsules & Health Ingredients
* Highlights in our history
* Markets we serve
* Global network
* Sustainability

#### We are capsule and health ingredients experts

Powered by industry-leading technologies, science-backed ingredients and a rich history in the
pharmaceutical and nutraceutical markets, we are more than just our products. We are capsule
experts, ingredient scientists and manufacturers with a solutions-focused mindset and we have been
helping brands overcome challenges for more than 100 years.

We support brands with a broad range of hard empty capsules for the pharmaceutical and nutraceutical
industries, including clean label and plant-based alternatives, as well as innovative delivery
technologies.

In addition, we offer a range of science-backed specialty health ingredients. Fueled by
consumer-centric data, our ingredients enable brands to disrupt the nutraceutical market with
purposeful products for human and animal nutrition.

We are constantly evolving and innovating to help you deliver products that meet in-demand patient
and consumer needs, as well as key market trends. Our concept-to-market services can assist you in
designing, optimizing and manufacturing your unique dosage forms that meet evolving patient and
consumer requirements.

#### Our difference

We are the preferred partner for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical companies around the world.
Helping you to create purpose-led, market-disrupting products with a competitive edge requires a
deep commitment to excellence. We are dedicated to adding value to your brand at every stage of your
development process, from concept to consumer.

* 1970
  
  We introduced the most popular two-piece hard gelatin capsule in the world - Capsugel® Coni-Snap®
  Hard Gelatin Capsule. This technology is a patented, two-ring closure system facilitating
  high-speed filling processing and secure locking of capsule body and cap.
* 1985
  
  Our portfolio of premium grade L-carnitine ingredients began with the launch of Carnipure®
  L-carnitine crystalline, which accelerated research and development behind the important benefits
  of L-carnitine for human and animal health.
* 1986
  
  ChromeMate® niacin-bound chromium complex was launched, offering nutraceutical brands an
  opportunity to create science-backed solutions that help to maintain healthy cholesterol levels
  and support weight management.
* 1990
  
  Carnipure® L-carnitine tartrate was introduced into the nutraceutical market and the first human
  clinical trials were initiated, leading to groundbreaking new insights behind the role of
  L-carnitine in supporting exercise recovery.
* 1993
  
  Our journey exploring science-backed solutions to meet the needs of the pet and production animal
  markets began with the launch of Carniking® L-carnitine for pet health.
* 1997
  
  Super CitriMax® 60% HCA was launched into the nutraceutical market, offering brands a unique
  solution for satiety and appetite.
* 1998
  
  We transformed the pharmaceutical industry with the introduction of our DBCaps® over-encapsulation
  capsules. This is a double-blind solution with a tamper-evident design, addressing the clinical
  trial challenge of testing without bias.
* 2000
  
  Capsugel® Licaps® liquid-filled capsules were launched into the nutraceutical market with a
  revolutionary capsule sealing and fusion technology. This technology is specifically designed to
  encapsulate liquid-based and specialty powder formulations.
  
  In the same year, we brought our L-Optizinc® zinc mono-L-methionine sulfate ingredient to market,
  offering superior absorption, retention and antioxidant properties over other forms of zinc.
* 2001
  
  UC-II® undenatured type II collagen was launched, marking the beginning of its successful journey
  as a unique joint health ingredient, available for clinical trial investigation.
* 2008
  
  ResistAid® arabinogalactan was launched, making the unique immune health benefits of this
  ingredient available to brands in the nutraceutical market.
* 2009
  
  The gold standard in HPMC capsules was introduced — Capsugel® Vcaps® Plus HPMC capsules. This
  capsule is produced by specifically developed thermo-gelation processes, without the addition of
  gelling systems.
* 2011
  
  We introduced our DRcaps® designed release capsules. Created to protect sensitive ingredients like
  probiotics against stomach acid and release them at the right time and in the right location in
  the body, this capsule polymer allows brands to create more advanced products that target diverse
  health areas.
  
  We transformed the nutraceutical and pharmaceutical market through Plantcaps® pullulan capsules—a
  plant-based vegetarian alternative. This groundbreaking solution enables brands to meet the
  preferences of environmentally-conscious consumers and patients.

## [Advancing science to improve well-being][62]

Our business is to provide our customers and partners with expert, tailor-made and responsible
solutions in Pharmaceuticals and Personal care.

## People make our name

Since 1880, we share our scientific know-how towards improving well-being, health and beauty around
the world. We design, produce and market high-quality **pharmaceutical**** excipients** and
**natural cosmetic ingredients**, based on a deep understanding of our customers' needs.

## [Personal Care][63]

We are experts in two complementary fields: lipids and plant chemistry. This know-how enables us to
meet the latest market trends in both **natural performing actives** and **functional ingredients**,
recognized for their sensorial benefits.

## [Pharmaceuticals][64]

We offer **innovative lipid excipients** and **personalized technical support**, provided by fully
trained experts to accelerate customers’ development programs, for **pharmaceutical** and
**veterinary drugs**, as well as **dietary supplements**.

## News
* Corporate

### [Gattefossé accelerates production ramp-up at its Lufkin facility with eight validated
### ingredients][65]

Three pharmaceutical excipients and five cosmetic ingredients have now achieved manufacturing
equivalency.
[Lufkin plant]
* Personal care

### [Gattefossé unveils Silkaress™ and wraps skin with silk-like softness][66]

Silkaress™ mirrors the protective function of silk and responds to the current challenges of
adapting to unpredictable, sometimes extreme changes in the environment.
* Personal care

### [When science meets the senses: Gattefossé celebrates 30 years of sensory expertise
### excellence][67]

Since 1996, we have developed a structured approach to understand and measure sensory perceptions,
supporting the creation of high-performance formulations from the very design of its ingredients.
[30 years sensory expertise]
[All news][68]

## [Advancing science to improve well-being][62]

Our business is to provide our customers and partners with expert, tailor-made and responsible
solutions in Pharmaceuticals and Personal care.

## People make our name

Since 1880, we share our scientific know-how towards improving well-being, health and beauty around
the world. We design, produce and market high-quality **pharmaceutical**** excipients** and
**natural cosmetic ingredients**, based on a deep understanding of our customers' needs.

## [Personal Care][63]

We are experts in two complementary fields: lipids and plant chemistry. This know-how enables us to
meet the latest market trends in both **natural performing actives** and **functional ingredients**,
recognized for their sensorial benefits.

## [Pharmaceuticals][64]

We offer **innovative lipid excipients** and **personalized technical support**, provided by fully
trained experts to accelerate customers’ development programs, for **pharmaceutical** and
**veterinary drugs**, as well as **dietary supplements**.

## News
* Corporate

### [Gattefossé accelerates production ramp-up at its Lufkin facility with eight validated
### ingredients][65]

Three pharmaceutical excipients and five cosmetic ingredients have now achieved manufacturing
equivalency.
[Lufkin plant]
* Personal care

### [Gattefossé unveils Silkaress™ and wraps skin with silk-like softness][66]

Silkaress™ mirrors the protective function of silk and responds to the current challenges of
adapting to unpredictable, sometimes extreme changes in the environment.
* Personal care

### [When science meets the senses: Gattefossé celebrates 30 years of sensory expertise
### excellence][67]

Since 1996, we have developed a structured approach to understand and measure sensory perceptions,
supporting the creation of high-performance formulations from the very design of its ingredients.
[30 years sensory expertise]

### Europe

Zofingen

## Zofingen

Switzerland

Zofingen is the headquarters of the Siegfried Group and one of Siegfried’s two launch sites for
newly developed processes. The production site specializes in the development and commercial
manufacturing of active pharmaceutical ingredients (APIs) and intermediates, including high potency
APIs. Founded in 1873, the site has a broad portfolio of technological capabilities including
hydrogenation, organometallic and hydride chemistry, halogenation, methylation, milling and
micronization and more. All activities are conducted in strict compliance with quality standards
(GMPs) and with safety, health protection and environmental standards.

**Competencies**
* Active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) and intermediates
* Highly active and controlled substances
* Custom synthesis

## Evionnaz

Switzerland

Siegfried Evionnaz is one of Siegfried’s two launch sites for newly developed processes. It
specializes in custom synthesis of active ingredients and intermediates for the pharmaceutical
industry. With an R&D Center housing advanced chemical and analytical facilities, state-of-the-art
laboratories, and cutting-edge technologies, it offers chemical process R&D and analytical
development services for Siegfried’s global Drug Substances network. Established in 1957, the site
has a broad portfolio of technologies including micronization, azide chemistry, hydrogenation,
halogenation, organometallics, cryogenics, and more. Focused on niche technologies, the facility
possesses development capacity from 1 gram to industrial-scale production. All activities are
conducted in strict compliance with quality standards (GMPs) and with safety, health protection and
environmental standards.

**Competencies**
* Active pharmaceutical ingredients (API) and intermediates
* Custom synthesis

Siegfried Hameln is one of Siegfried’s six Drug Products sites globally. It is a leading
manufacturer of parenteral solutions, producing a wide range of aseptic and terminally sterilized
products in ampoules and vials, with a dedicated development center for sterile injectables. Its
specialization lies in the production of complex formulations, including anesthetics, flammable
substances, oxygen-sensitive liquids, and cold chain products, all while ensuring strict compliance
with quality standards (GMPs) and with safety, health protection and environmental standards. The
site has a broad portfolio of technological capabilities including cold-chain handling, automated
visual inspection and packing and more. All activities are conducted in strict compliance with
quality standards (GMPs) and with safety, health protection and environmental standards.

# America's #1 coatings distributor, by growth and volume.

Family-owned since 1991. We equip automotive, aerospace, marine, and military operations with the
world's finest coatings, supplies, and equipment — as the strategic Surventis (BASF) and direct 3M
distributor, with multiple delivery runs across Southern California every day.

[ Explore Our Partners ][16][Contact Sales][17]

## Every brand that matters. Under one roof.

50+ premium lines, all sourced through authorized channels.

## Ranked first in the nation.

In 2025, BASF Coatings named A&F Auto Paint & Supply its largest distributor in the country by
volume — recognition earned through decades of repeated year-over-year growth and relationships
built one shop at a time.

Why Shops Switch

## Shops don't leave us. They switch to us.

Every account we've won came from a distributor who over-promised and under-delivered. Here's what
changes the day you switch.

[ Make the Switch ][19]

### Multiple deliveries, every day

Our trucks run your route morning and afternoon — not once a week. Order at 9 AM and it's often on
your bench the same day.

### A real person answers

No phone trees, no ticket queues. Your rep knows your shop, your paint lines, and your order
history.

### Your mixing system, installed free

Switch your paint line to us and we install the complete Surventis (BASF) color system — mixing
machine, computer, scale, and spectrophotometer — at no charge.

### Unmatched buying power

The largest BASF Coatings distributor in the country — that scale shows up in your pricing, your
stock, and your support.

What We Supply

## Coatings. Supplies. Equipment.

Three divisions, one standard: everything a professional operation needs, from the paint itself to
the machinery it runs on.

01

### Paint & Coatings

Full systems from the world's leading coatings makers — primers, basecoats, clears, and specialty
finishes for every substrate and spec.
* Glasurit, R-M & Baslac by Surventis (BASF)
* Primers, sealers & clearcoats
* Industrial & specialty coatings
* Color matching & tint support

[ Inquire about a paint machine ][20]
02

### Supplies & Consumables

Everything the booth and the bay burn through daily — abrasives, masking, fillers, adhesives, and
PPE from authorized channels.
* 3M abrasives, tapes & systems
* Sandpaper, discs & blocks
* Fillers, adhesives & sealers
* Respirators, gloves & PPE

[ See our partners ][21]
03

### Equipment & Machinery

The heavy iron that runs a professional operation — from spray guns and booths to car benches and
frame machinery, with setup support.
* Spray guns & cup systems
* Spray booths & filtration
* Car benches & frame machines
* Install & service support

[ Plan your equipment ][22]

Industries We Serve

## Wherever a finish matters.

From collision centers to defense contractors — six industries rely on A&F for coatings, supplies,
and equipment.

01

### Automotive

Collision centers, dealerships, and custom shops — our foundation since 1991.

02

### Aerospace

Certified coatings and materials for airframe and component finishing.

03

### Aviation

Refinish systems and supplies for fleet and general aviation operations.

04

### Industrial

Protective and performance coatings for manufacturing and infrastructure.

05

### Marine

Finishes and materials engineered for hulls, decks, and harsh saltwater duty.

06

### Military

Spec-compliant coatings and supply programs for defense applications.

Strategic Partnerships

## Partnered at the highest level.

Not every distributor is created equal. A&F holds top-tier distribution agreements with the world's
leading coatings and materials manufacturers.

[Surventis]Strategic Distributor

A&F is an authorized strategic distributor for Surventis — formerly BASF Coatings, following the

As a direct 3M distributor, every abrasive, tape, and system we supply comes factory-direct —

# Paint the future with AkzoNobel

Ever since we first lifted the lid on our paints and coatings in 1792, we’ve been coloring people’s
lives and protecting what matters most. From deep underground, to homes, cities, transport and even
outer space, we use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life.

Let's Paint the Future together.

take a look at the Q1 highlights. 

[ View report ][50]

## Creating a world-leading coatings company

AkzoNobel and Axalta have announced an all-stock merger of equals, brining together two iconic
industry leaders.

[ Deal overview ][51] [ Read media release ][52]

## Colors of the Year 2026

Get into the swing of things with Rhythm of Blues, our Colors of the Year for 2026. It’s an upbeat
and versatile color family based around three shades that are designed to bring calm, balance and
energy. The focus is on your space, your pace to help you create a visual soundtrack that gets your
mojo working.

[ Read more ][53]

# About us

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,
International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more
than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what
we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together.

Our search for better never stops. We’re driven to find innovative, more sustainable solutions for

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s
lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux,

than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance everyday life. Because we believe
every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established
paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what

## Vorteile ready-to-use Produkte

bestehenden Tablettiermasse beimischen oder in Wasser dispergieren, um eine Filmüberzugssuspension
herzustellen.

* kundenspezifische Formulierung
* 1 Produkt, weniger Dokumentation
* in einem Schritt anwendbar
* schnelles und einfaches Handling
* gleichbleibende und reproduzierbare Qualität
* niedriges Lieferkettenrisiko
* einfache Logistik
* kürzere Produktionszeiten

### [2026 Nasal & Inhalation Drug Development & Delivery eBook: Drug Repurposing Creates New Market
### Opportunities][16]

In this exclusive seventh annual nasal and inhalation eBook, Drug Development & Delivery highlights
how these routes of administration are bringing new life to orphaned drugs and open new
opportunities for treatment beyond pulmonary and respiratory diseases. We also explore the
challenges of nose-to-brain delivery, next-generation propellants, overcoming the limitations of dry
powder inhalers, and successful formulation strategies.

[Featured Articles][17]

### [SPECIAL FEATURE - Outsourcing Formulation Development & Manufacturing: Connecting Your Project
### to the Right Service Provider][18]

Outsourcing formulation development and manufacturing can help drug developers address complex
dosage forms, scale-up risks, regulatory demands, and accelerated timelines by connecting projects
with CDMO partners that offer specialized expertise, integrated workflows, and scalable
manufacturing support.

[Featured Articles][19]

### [SPECIAL REPORT - Advancements in Respiratory Drug Delivery][20]

Advances in inhaled drug delivery are improving how therapies reach the lungs, with innovations in
formulations, devices, biologics, and digital tools helping expand treatment options for respiratory
diseases.

[Featured Articles][21]

### [CAR T CELL THERAPY - The Rise of Scalable Allogeneic CAR T: Shaping a New Era in Oncology][22]

Allogeneic CAR T therapies are helping move oncology toward more scalable, off-the-shelf treatment
models that could expand access, support earlier intervention, and bring advanced cell therapy
closer to community cancer settings.

[Featured Articles][23]

### [EXECUTIVE INTERVIEW - Dr. Michalis Papadakis Founder & CEO Brainomix][24]

Brainomix founder and CEO Dr. Michalis Papadakis discusses how AI-powered imaging is helping drug
developers improve clinical trial design, identify meaningful treatment effects, and advance new
therapies in stroke, pulmonary fibrosis, and other areas of unmet need.

[Featured Articles][25]

### [DRUG-DEVICE COMBINATION PRODUCTS - Incorporating Self-Administered Drug-Device Combination
### Products Into Clinical Trials Can Bring Outsized Challenges & Outstanding Rewards][26]

Self-administered drug-device combination products can bring major benefits to clinical trials,
improving patient convenience, dosing consistency, compliance, and real-world insight, but they
require careful early planning around usability, safety, regulatory requirements, compatibility,
manufacturing, and scale-up.

[Featured Articles][27]

### [DRUG DELIVERY - Improved Prediction of Food Effect on Oral Absorption][28]

Dissolution-permeation testing is helping drug developers better predict how food affects oral drug
absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

[Featured Articles][29]

### [DRUG DEVELOPMENT - Drug Combination Screening in Oncology: Advancing Predictive Strategies for
### Precision Drug Development][30]

Drug combination screening is helping oncology developers identify synergistic drug pairs, connect
response patterns to tumor biology, and support more predictive, biomarker-guided strategies for
precision cancer treatment.

[Featured Articles][31]

### [SINGLE B CELL ANTIBODY DISCOVERY - Improving Therapeutic Candidate Selection in Drug
### Development][32]

Single B cell antibody discovery is helping improve therapeutic candidate selection by preserving
native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

[Featured Articles][33]

### [CHEMOENZYMATIC LIGATION - Enabling Scalable, Sustainable Oligonucleotide Manufacturing][34]

Chemoenzymatic ligation offers a scalable, more sustainable path for oligonucleotide manufacturing
by combining SPOS fragment production with enzymatic assembly to improve purity, reduce impurities,
and support growing demand for nucleic acid therapeutics.

[Featured Articles][35]

### [CONTROLLED RELEASE - Precision in Every Dose: Advancing Controlled Release for Small Molecule
### Therapeutics][36]

Controlled release technologies are helping small molecule therapeutics deliver more consistent drug
exposure, improve patient adherence, reduce dosing frequency, and support more precise treatment
through advanced formulation and delivery strategies.

[Featured Articles][37]

how these routes of administration are bringing new life to orphaned drugs and open new
opportunities for treatment beyond pulmonary and respiratory diseases. We also explore the
challenges of nose-to-brain delivery, next-generation propellants, overcoming the limitations of dry
powder inhalers, and successful formulation strategies.

[Featured Articles][17]

### [SPECIAL FEATURE - Outsourcing Formulation Development & Manufacturing: Connecting Your Project
### to the Right Service Provider][18]

Outsourcing formulation development and manufacturing can help drug developers address complex
dosage forms, scale-up risks, regulatory demands, and accelerated timelines by connecting projects
with CDMO partners that offer specialized expertise, integrated workflows, and scalable
manufacturing support.

[Featured Articles][19]

### [SPECIAL REPORT - Advancements in Respiratory Drug Delivery][20]

Advances in inhaled drug delivery are improving how therapies reach the lungs, with innovations in
formulations, devices, biologics, and digital tools helping expand treatment options for respiratory
diseases.

[Featured Articles][21]

### [CAR T CELL THERAPY - The Rise of Scalable Allogeneic CAR T: Shaping a New Era in Oncology][22]

Allogeneic CAR T therapies are helping move oncology toward more scalable, off-the-shelf treatment
models that could expand access, support earlier intervention, and bring advanced cell therapy
closer to community cancer settings.

[Featured Articles][23]

### [EXECUTIVE INTERVIEW - Dr. Michalis Papadakis Founder & CEO Brainomix][24]

Brainomix founder and CEO Dr. Michalis Papadakis discusses how AI-powered imaging is helping drug
developers improve clinical trial design, identify meaningful treatment effects, and advance new
therapies in stroke, pulmonary fibrosis, and other areas of unmet need.

[Featured Articles][25]

### [DRUG-DEVICE COMBINATION PRODUCTS - Incorporating Self-Administered Drug-Device Combination
### Products Into Clinical Trials Can Bring Outsized Challenges & Outstanding Rewards][26]

Self-administered drug-device combination products can bring major benefits to clinical trials,
improving patient convenience, dosing consistency, compliance, and real-world insight, but they
require careful early planning around usability, safety, regulatory requirements, compatibility,
manufacturing, and scale-up.

[Featured Articles][27]

### [DRUG DELIVERY - Improved Prediction of Food Effect on Oral Absorption][28]

Dissolution-permeation testing is helping drug developers better predict how food affects oral drug
absorption by measuring both drug solubilization and membrane permeation, reducing the risk of
misleading results from dissolution data alone.

[Featured Articles][29]

### [DRUG DEVELOPMENT - Drug Combination Screening in Oncology: Advancing Predictive Strategies for
### Precision Drug Development][30]

Drug combination screening is helping oncology developers identify synergistic drug pairs, connect
response patterns to tumor biology, and support more predictive, biomarker-guided strategies for
precision cancer treatment.

[Featured Articles][31]

### [SINGLE B CELL ANTIBODY DISCOVERY - Improving Therapeutic Candidate Selection in Drug
### Development][32]

Single B cell antibody discovery is helping improve therapeutic candidate selection by preserving
native heavy- and light-chain pairing, accelerating sequence-defined screening, and enabling earlier
identification of candidates with stronger specificity, function, and developability.

[Featured Articles][33]

### [CHEMOENZYMATIC LIGATION - Enabling Scalable, Sustainable Oligonucleotide Manufacturing][34]

Chemoenzymatic ligation offers a scalable, more sustainable path for oligonucleotide manufacturing
by combining SPOS fragment production with enzymatic assembly to improve purity, reduce impurities,
and support growing demand for nucleic acid therapeutics.

[Featured Articles][35]

### [CONTROLLED RELEASE - Precision in Every Dose: Advancing Controlled Release for Small Molecule
### Therapeutics][36]

Controlled release technologies are helping small molecule therapeutics deliver more consistent drug
exposure, improve patient adherence, reduce dosing frequency, and support more precise treatment
through advanced formulation and delivery strategies.

[Featured Articles][37]

### [BIOCATALYSIS - Biocatalysis Without Barriers for Efficient Small Molecule Process
### Development][38]

Masha Kononov and Reuben Carr examine both the promise and the practical constraints of biocatalysis
in modern drug substance development, as well as the role of contract research, development and
manufacturing organizations (CRD-MOs) in meeting the evolving demands of modern small molecule
synthesis.

[Contract Services,][39] [Featured Articles][40]

### [SPECIAL FEATURE - PFS & Parenteral Manufacturing: Rapid Growth of Injectables Places
### Unprecedented Demands on Parenteral Manufacturing][41]

Contributor Cindy H. Dubin highlights many of these CDMOs as well as innovations in the PFS sector.

[Contract Services,][42] [Featured Articles][43]

### [FORMULATION FORUM - Supercritical Carbon Dioxide (scCO2) for Improving Solubility & Oral
### Bioavailability of Drugs][44]

Shaukat Ali, PhD, and Jim Huang, PhD, discuss as more new chemical entities coming out of discovery
are poorly soluble (BCS Class II and IV), the scCO2 is taking an aim to find the desired solutions
to help improve the bottleneck in the industry.

[Featured Articles][45]

### [TKIS - Next-Generation BCR-ABL TKIs for CML: The Allosteric Era][46]

Emil Kuriakose, MD, explores the current CML treatment landscape, ongoing clinical challenges, and
the potential of next-generation TKIs currently in development, offering hope for the growing CML
community.

Chitra Machineries Pvt. Ltd. is a well-known development firm that offers its clients a wide range
of industrial used products. Over the years, our name has been synonymous with the design and
manufacture of high-quality machinery for the food, cosmetics, chemical, medicine, and
pharmaceutical industries. Our offered range includes items like Contra Rotating Mixer, Double Cone
Blender, Automatic Tablet Coating System, Blender With V And Double Cone, Rapid Mixer Granulator,
and more. All of these products are made from high-quality raw materials, processed using advanced
equipment, and packaged in accordance with worldwide industrial standards. Along with these items,
we offer extended after-sales service to our clients across the world at cheap costs.

From idea creation, R&D, and design to contract manufacture, packing, and final shipment, we are
one-stop shop for a diverse range of machinery solutions. Our knowledge is respected and used by
both large and small businesses to maximize the return on capital equipment. Building our business
by collaborating with our customers, we have established the methods and technologies to build all
types of customized machinery to match the exact specifications of our clients, based on the process
and production requirements of our customers. We always judge and measure our success based on the
success of our customers, regardless of the quantity of the order. Our dedication and years of
experience has made us one of the most reliable manufacturer and supplier in the market.

**Our Strengths **

Our innate strengths have given us a competitive advantage in our industry. These includes:

* We continue to invest in our infrastructure to improve the quality and performance of our
  products, as well as our response to the individual needs of our customers. Our new equipment
  manufacturing plant is approximately 33,000 square feet in size, with an additional 22,000 square
  feet of building space.      
* We manufacture each products with the purpose to provide equipment that allows our customers to
  achieve their unique business goals.
* We preserve all of the relevant information for each machine we supply. With this information, we
  can provide reliable after-sales care to our valued clients.
* We have established an R&D section that aims to improve our existing product line while also
  conducting research on new equipment.
* We always aim to achieve total customer satisfaction. Improving the businesses of our customers
  through our products is a top priority, thus we hire the most knowledgeable and devoted team
  members. We train them to perform their best and make every transaction valuable and profitable
  for our clients.

About Us
Chitra Machineries Pvt. Ltd. is a well-known development firm that offers its clients a wide range
of industrial used products. Over the years, our name has been synonymous with the design and
manufacture of high-quality machinery for the food, cosmetics, chemical, medicine, and
pharmaceutical industries. Our offered range includes items like Contra Rotating Mixer, Double Cone
Blender, Automatic Tablet Coating System, Blender With V And Double Cone, Rapid Mixer Granulator,
and more. All of these products are made from high-quality raw materials, processed using advanced
equipment, and packaged in accordance with worldwide industrial standards. Along with these items,
we offer extended after-sales service to our clients across the world at cheap costs.

From idea creation, R&D, and design to contract manufacture, packing, and final shipment, we are
one-stop shop for a diverse range of machinery solutions. Our knowledge is respected and used by
both large and small businesses to maximize the return on capital equipment. Building our business
by collaborating with our customers, we have established the methods and technologies to build all
types of customized machinery to match the exact specifications of our clients, based on the process
and production requirements of our customers. We always judge and measure our success based on the
success of our customers, regardless of the quantity of the order. Our dedication and years of
experience has made us one of the most reliable manufacturer and supplier in the market.

**Our Strengths **

Our innate strengths have given us a competitive advantage in our industry. These includes:

* We continue to invest in our infrastructure to improve the quality and performance of our
  products, as well as our response to the individual needs of our customers. Our new equipment
  manufacturing plant is approximately 33,000 square feet in size, with an additional 22,000 square
  feet of building space.      
* We manufacture each products with the purpose to provide equipment that allows our customers to
  achieve their unique business goals.
* We preserve all of the relevant information for each machine we supply. With this information, we
  can provide reliable after-sales care to our valued clients.
* We have established an R&D section that aims to improve our existing product line while also
  conducting research on new equipment.
* We always aim to achieve total customer satisfaction. Improving the businesses of our customers
  through our products is a top priority, thus we hire the most knowledgeable and devoted team
  members. We train them to perform their best and make every transaction valuable and profitable
  for our clients.

## Raw Materials & Parts

Top-quality pharmaceutical packing machines begin at material selection, with the integrity of each
part contributing to the overall performance of the machinery.

At JL, we only use non-toxic and pollution-free raw materials sourced from reliable local and
international material suppliers in creating our machinery. The electrical parts come from
well-known makers in Japan, Germany, and the US. We can guarantee consistent performance and easy
maintenance by opting for the best materials and parts.

* Contactor: South Korea LG

* Control Panel Mounting Enclosure : MECANO
* PLC : Siemens, Panasonic, Proface Pro-face

## CNC

Well-made molds and parts are vital to successful pharmaceutical processing. This is why we have
invested in sophisticated CNC equipment to skyrocket the accuracy of the molds, turntables, and
parts used in our machines, thus ensuring the machine’s high quality and the operation’s stability.

Beyond that, we also use high-quality materials like GCR15 to produce molds to ensure quality and
precision. Each mold has superior durability and is usable multiple times.

## Testing

We also conduct multiple machine tests like mold tolerance and fatigue testing, along with using the
intended materials for production to see their performance while adjusting for optimization.

As a worldwide pharmaceutical packaging machinery supplier, we abide by strict quality standards,
including testing and inspection. Our machines pass CE, RoHS, EMC, and LVD certifications, ensuring
you can market them to any region without hassle.

use.

products and packaging materials. Before delivering them to your personnel, our team handles

transit.

supports. Molds are packed with foam or airbag filling for stability, with a layer of plastic film
for waterproofing. Additionally, we coat the machines with anti-rust agents to prevent corrosion or
rusting.

use.

products and packaging materials. Before delivering them to your personnel, our team handles
assembly, testing, and machine qualification.

transit.

coating systems that bring solutions.

understand how expensive and valuable wood products can be, therefore we continue to design products

## About Us

KAPCI Coatings was established in 1985 as a private company only devoted for the production of car
refinishes till 1999. We were producing Nitrocellulose car refinish till 1996 when we introduced to
the Egyptian market the most successful 2 component acrylic polyurethane color mix system for car
refinish based on our own know-how.

[Read More][41]

## Automotive Refinish

Automotive refinishing requires highly specialized and quality products. At Kapci Coatings we
continue to develop car refinish products that are highly innovative. Our mission is to produce
coating systems that bring solutions.

[Read More][42]

## Wood Coatings

Our wood range is specially formulated for curing, beautifying and protecting of wood surfaces. We
understand how expensive and valuable wood products can be, therefore we continue to design products
that meet the ever changing tastes.

[Read More][43]

## **Decorative Paints**

Our decorative range is used in decorating, protecting and enhancing durability in all architectural
applications, wood, metal, PVC and plastic substrates.  The products come in personalized and
versatile colours that meet the choices.

[Read More][44]

## INK

KAPCI Coatings And Sun Chemical offers a broad ink and coating product portfolio with a wide range
of capabilities that include flexographic packaging inks, energy-curable inks and coatings, label
and narrow web inks.

# Μια ελληνική παράδοση **ποιότητας και καινοτομίας**

Ιδρυμένη το 1968, η KARAMANIS έχει εξελιχθεί  σε κατασκευαστή επικαλύψεων με ζάχαρη και σε κορυφαίο
προμηθευτή επικαλύψεων με σοκολάτα. Με ισχυρή δέσμευση στην ποιότητα, την καινοτομία και την
ικανοποίηση των πελατών, έχουμε χτίσει μια φήμη για την αριστεία στον κλάδο.


[Follow a manual added link][30]

# Το ταξίδι μας

**Ξεχωρίζοντας στην επικάλυψη από το 1968**

Από μια μικρή ελληνική εταιρεία , εξελιχθήκαμε σε ηγέτη του κλάδου στην επικάλυψη ζάχαρης και την
επεξεργασία σοκολάτας. Η προσπάθειά μας για καινοτομία και τεχνογνωσία μας επέτρεψε να επεκτείνουμε
την γκάμα των προϊόντων μας, προσφέροντας προϊόντα που καλύπτουν τις ανάγκες των εταιρειών τροφίμων,
ζαχαρωδών προϊόντων και λιανικής πώλησης. Σήμερα, τα τελικά προϊόντα μας αγαπιούνται από αρτοποιεία,
ζαχαροπλάστες, λιανοπωλητές και οργανωτές εκδηλώσεων.

**Οικογενειακή Χειροτεχνία**

Η Karamanis είναι μια πραγματική οικογενειακή επιχείρηση, όπου όλα τα μέλη συνεργάζονται με μια
εξαιρετική ομάδα και ένα κοινό πάθος για καλαίσθητα προϊόντα, δημιουργώντας προϊόντα υψηλής
ποιότητας βασισμένα στην παράδοση, την εμπιστοσύνη και τη δεξιοτεχνία.

**1968 – σήμερα**

**Αν είναι βρώσιμο,
θα βρούμε έναν τρόπο να το επικαλύψουμε.**

Στην Karamanis, η καινοτομία τροφοδοτεί την ανάπτυξή μας.

Είτε πρόκειται για φρούτα, μπισκότα, δημητριακά ή ξηρούς καρπούς, θα βρούμε έναν τρόπο να το

# Μια ελληνική παράδοση **ποιότητας και καινοτομίας**

Ιδρυμένη το 1968, η KARAMANIS έχει εξελιχθεί  σε κατασκευαστή επικαλύψεων με ζάχαρη και σε κορυφαίο
προμηθευτή επικαλύψεων με σοκολάτα. Με ισχυρή δέσμευση στην ποιότητα, την καινοτομία και την
ικανοποίηση των πελατών, έχουμε χτίσει μια φήμη για την αριστεία στον κλάδο.


[Follow a manual added link][30]

# Το ταξίδι μας

**Ξεχωρίζοντας στην επικάλυψη από το 1968**

Από μια μικρή ελληνική εταιρεία , εξελιχθήκαμε σε ηγέτη του κλάδου στην επικάλυψη ζάχαρης και την
επεξεργασία σοκολάτας. Η προσπάθειά μας για καινοτομία και τεχνογνωσία μας επέτρεψε να επεκτείνουμε
την γκάμα των προϊόντων μας, προσφέροντας προϊόντα που καλύπτουν τις ανάγκες των εταιρειών τροφίμων,
ζαχαρωδών προϊόντων και λιανικής πώλησης. Σήμερα, τα τελικά προϊόντα μας αγαπιούνται από αρτοποιεία,
ζαχαροπλάστες, λιανοπωλητές και οργανωτές εκδηλώσεων.

**Οικογενειακή Χειροτεχνία**

Η Karamanis είναι μια πραγματική οικογενειακή επιχείρηση, όπου όλα τα μέλη συνεργάζονται με μια
εξαιρετική ομάδα και ένα κοινό πάθος για καλαίσθητα προϊόντα, δημιουργώντας προϊόντα υψηλής
ποιότητας βασισμένα στην παράδοση, την εμπιστοσύνη και τη δεξιοτεχνία.

**1968 – σήμερα**

**Αν είναι βρώσιμο,
θα βρούμε έναν τρόπο να το επικαλύψουμε.**

Στην Karamanis, η καινοτομία τροφοδοτεί την ανάπτυξή μας.

Είτε πρόκειται για φρούτα, μπισκότα, δημητριακά ή ξηρούς καρπούς, θα βρούμε έναν τρόπο να το
επικαλύψουμε.

# KBS Coatings: The 3-Step System That Stops Rust Permanently on Any Metal Surface
* Proper surface PREPARATION
* Permanent SEPARATION of water & oxygen from metal.

While [RustSeal][220] will provide superior rust protection when coated directly over a minimally
prepared surface, only KBS Coatings' unique 3-Step System offers the ideal surface preparation and
unmatched ability to Stop Rust.

This proven [3-Step System][221] includes:
* [KBS Klean][222] - a water-based concentrated cleaner/degreaser which leaves no residue.
* [RustBlast][223] - a powerful, water-based, rust remover and zinc phosphate and metal etch.
* [RustSeal][224] - a one part, ready-to-use, high-solid content, rock-hard, paint over rust
  coating.

[[Stop Rust with KBS RustSeal]][225]
[ [KBS Coatings] ][226]

[+Click Here for more on the KBS 3 Step Rust Prevention System.][227]

Before investing the time and effort into your next auto restoration, industrial maintenance, or
home corrosion project, remember ...
K B S or Klean - Blast - Seal
... it's your formula for success! Guaranteed!

As well as the Most Popular Rust Prevention products, KBS Coatings also features [Gas Tank Sealer
Kits][228], [1K Clear Coats][229], [2K Clear Coats][230], [1K Aerosol Top Coats & Clear Coats][231],
[1K Brush, Spray or Roll Top Coats][232], [2K Top Coats][233], [Cavity Waxes][234], [Engine
Paints][235], [Exhaust Paints][236], [Header Paints][237], [Smoker Paints][238], [Epoxy
Putties][239], [Paint & Strippers][240], [Undercoatings][241], [Paint Thinners][242], [Disposable
Gloves][243] and so much more.

[RustSeal][251]
[RustSeal is a single-component, ready-to-use rust encapsulating coating that permanently stops rust
and prevents its return. It bonds to clean or lightly rusted metal and cures to a rock-hard,
ceramic-like finish that resists road salts, fuel, and most chemicals without cracking, peeling, or
chipping. Applied in thin coats with a minimum of two coats recommended, RustSeal delivers long-term
rust protection on automotive frames, undercoatings, fuel tanks, trailers, and industrial
metalwork.][252]

RustSeal, a moisture-cured coating that chemically bonds to metal and won't crack, chip, or peel.

# KBS Coatings: The 3-Step System That Stops Rust Permanently on Any Metal Surface
* Proper surface PREPARATION
* Permanent SEPARATION of water & oxygen from metal.

While [RustSeal][220] will provide superior rust protection when coated directly over a minimally
prepared surface, only KBS Coatings' unique 3-Step System offers the ideal surface preparation and
unmatched ability to Stop Rust.

This proven [3-Step System][221] includes:
* [KBS Klean][222] - a water-based concentrated cleaner/degreaser which leaves no residue.
* [RustBlast][223] - a powerful, water-based, rust remover and zinc phosphate and metal etch.
* [RustSeal][224] - a one part, ready-to-use, high-solid content, rock-hard, paint over rust
  coating.

[[Stop Rust with KBS RustSeal]][225]
[ [KBS Coatings] ][226]

[+Click Here for more on the KBS 3 Step Rust Prevention System.][227]

Before investing the time and effort into your next auto restoration, industrial maintenance, or
home corrosion project, remember ...
K B S or Klean - Blast - Seal
... it's your formula for success! Guaranteed!

As well as the Most Popular Rust Prevention products, KBS Coatings also features [Gas Tank Sealer
Kits][228], [1K Clear Coats][229], [2K Clear Coats][230], [1K Aerosol Top Coats & Clear Coats][231],
[1K Brush, Spray or Roll Top Coats][232], [2K Top Coats][233], [Cavity Waxes][234], [Engine
Paints][235], [Exhaust Paints][236], [Header Paints][237], [Smoker Paints][238], [Epoxy
Putties][239], [Paint & Strippers][240], [Undercoatings][241], [Paint Thinners][242], [Disposable
Gloves][243] and so much more.

At Kerry, we enable better food and beverage; partnering with our customers to create healthier,

undeniable. The good news? We're ready for it.

health challenges. Through our work with customers, we’re helping c. 1.5 billion people eat
healthier, more nutritious food, with a goal of reaching 2 billion by 2030.

# Creating a world of
# 
# Sustainable Nutrition

At Kerry, we enable better food and beverage; partnering with our customers to create healthier,
tastier, and more sustainable products that are enjoyed by consumers all around the world.

 

[Learn more][89]

## Latest news

Discover what’s on the horizon for food, beverage and pharma.

### The Reformulation Trap: Why Better-for-You Bakery So Often Tastes Like It

[Read more][90]

### From Hormonal Chaos to Cycle Confidence: Why Fertility Support is Being Rethought Across Asia

[Read more][91]

### Kerry Welcomes Harvard’s Professor of the Global Food System to Ireland for Discussion on the
### Future of Food

[Read more][92]

In a squeeze?

## Don't wait, reformulate 

Reformulating products to meet consumer expectations amidst complex regulatory environments, rising
costs, and global supply chain disruptions can be overwhelming. Add shifting consumer priorities
around health and sustainability to the mix, and the need for fast, effective solutions is
undeniable. The good news? We're ready for it.

[Learn more][93]
[person drinking juice]

From Food For Food

## Delivering value for our partners for over 50 years.

We play our part in tackling global health challenges by reducing excess salt and sugar, increasing
fibre intake, eliminating harmful compounds in foods, and pioneering solutions that manage profound
health challenges. Through our work with customers, we’re helping c. 1.5 billion people eat
healthier, more nutritious food, with a goal of reaching 2 billion by 2030. 

[Learn more][94]
[couple sharing a sandwich]

## Clinical science with human impact.

By combining premium, clinically proven ingredients with our unmatched ingenuity in taste, we’re
creating leading-edge health and wellness solutions that blend the very best of science, sourcing
and sensory.

[Explore Supplement solutions][95]
[african woman proudly smiling]

## Nutritionally Optimised. Taste Maximised. 

Taste is the ultimate non-negotiable.   

As consumers continue to seek out healthier lifestyles and practices, sugar and artificial
sweeteners are in the spotlight.

This is where Kerry can come in. Customer solutions like our Tastesense™ Advanced can reduce sugar
by up to 80% using only natural ingredients and with no compromise on taste. 

[Explore our Taste solutions][96]
[african woman proudly smiling]

OUR
MISSION
We see our mission as protecting every surface with our coatings, making the use of material objects
easier and more enjoyable.
All our products are known for their innovation, but one stands out among the rest: our famous top
coat, MEGA 10. We have managed to add non-organic glass to the composition, which makes it unique.

Available exclusively for select dealers and highly professional detailers, following a special
explanatory course.
MEGA 10
TRY ONCE, USE ALWAYS
Titanium protective coating for paintwork

* Protects paint from fading and maintains its natural color
* Decreases the possibility of chipping
* Reduces risks of corrosion development
* Minimizes the risk of paintwork damage at car wash stations using low-grade chemical products and
  low-skilled personnel
* Creates an anti-graffiti effect when two layers are applied
* Enhances shine, depth and intensity of paintwork color
ADVANTAGES OF OUR COATINGS
* **Ease of Application**
  All KRYTEX™ coatings are easy and quick to apply.
* **Quick Multi-Layer Application**
  It is possible to create a multi-layered coating in the shortest possible time for maximum effect
* Long-Lasting Protection
  Our coatings offer guaranteed long-term surface protection, eliminating the need for regular
  renewal
* Chemical Resistance
  Our coatings offer guaranteed resistance to high-potency chemical exposure
* Mechanical Impact Resistance
  Our coatings provide guaranteed resistance to significant mechanical impact during normal car
  maintenance
* Certified Quality
  We have all the official documents confirming the stated features of our coatings
Our products are designed for detailing professionals, and we are confident that our future partners
and dealers are knowledgeable about detailing and protective coatings application.

Nevertheless, our coatings have some unique features that need to be understood before the
application process begins.

For everyone who starts working with KRYTEX™, we provide a special explanatory course to help you
achieve maximum results in detailing. We offer two options: a 2-day course for beginners and a 1-day
course for detailers with experience in protective coatings application.
KRYTEX™
PROFESSIONAL ASSISTANCE
KRYTEX™ sales strategy is straightforward – we only sell our coatings to our partners and
distributors. Partners (typically detailers) use KRYTEX™ products exclusively for themselves or
their customers, while distributors are entitled to resell to other companies.

We are always interested in widening of our network, so we are inviting new partners and
distributors to join our team!
To receive the conditions of becoming a partner or a distributor, please send us a message to
[info@krytexgroup.com][67] and our managers will provide you with necessary information. Join our
team!

# Professional Coating Systems

Die MIPA SE zählt zu den weltweit größten und erfolgreichsten familiengeführten Unternehmen der
Lack- und Farbenbranche. Am Hauptsitz in Essenbach und an sieben weiteren europäischen Standorten
entwickeln und produzieren Unternehmen der Mipa Gruppe Beschichtungssysteme für verschiedenste
Anwendungsbereiche.

Neben Fahrzeugreparaturlacken, Lacken für die Industrie und Bautenfarben umfasst das Mipa
Produktsortiment auch Holz- und Schreinerlacke sowie Lackierzubehör für professionelle Anwender.

Die Mipa Gruppe ist weltweit mit rund 1700 Beschäftigten tätig und beliefert eigene Niederlassungen
sowie Partner in über 100 Ländern auf allen Kontinenten.

## Bleiben Sie up-to-date

Wir verstehen uns nicht nur als Anbieter eines Komplettsortiments, sondern unterstützen und
begleiten unsere Kunden auch bei allen Schritten des Lackierprozesses. Mit Schulungen in unserem
Schulungszentrum am Hauptsitz in Essenbach sowie an sechs weiteren Trainingszentren weltweit, welche
auch individuell nach Ihren Vorstellungen geplant werden können, bleiben Sie immer auf dem neuesten
Stand der Dinge und lernen frühzeitig, welche neuen Technologien wichtig sind, was im Trend ist und
wie noch weiter für effizientes Arbeiten in der Lackierkabine gesorgt werden kann.

Im Downloadbereich bieten wir mit unseren Produktkatalogen sowie Flyern, Broschüren und Videos auch
viele andere Möglichkeiten, um sich gezielt über MIPA und das gesamte Produktsortiment zu
informieren.

# Professional Coating Systems

Die MIPA SE zählt zu den weltweit größten und erfolgreichsten familiengeführten Unternehmen der
Lack- und Farbenbranche. Am Hauptsitz in Essenbach und an sieben weiteren europäischen Standorten
entwickeln und produzieren Unternehmen der Mipa Gruppe Beschichtungssysteme für verschiedenste
Anwendungsbereiche.

Neben Fahrzeugreparaturlacken, Lacken für die Industrie und Bautenfarben umfasst das Mipa
Produktsortiment auch Holz- und Schreinerlacke sowie Lackierzubehör für professionelle Anwender.

Die Mipa Gruppe ist weltweit mit rund 1700 Beschäftigten tätig und beliefert eigene Niederlassungen
sowie Partner in über 100 Ländern auf allen Kontinenten.

## Mipa Produktsortiment

Lösungen für alle Anforderungen

Die Entwicklung und Herstellung hochwertiger Lacke für den Fahrzeugreparaturbereich, industrielle
Anwendungen sowie Holzoberflächen und Bauten ist unsere Kernkompetenz. Dank zahlreicher Synergien
innerhalb dieser Geschäftsbereiche bieten wir viele Zusatz- und Ergänzungsprodukte sowie
individuelle Problemlösungen an, um alle Kunden umfassend bedienen zu können.

[Mehr erfahren][56]

## Bleiben Sie up-to-date

Wir verstehen uns nicht nur als Anbieter eines Komplettsortiments, sondern unterstützen und
begleiten unsere Kunden auch bei allen Schritten des Lackierprozesses. Mit Schulungen in unserem
Schulungszentrum am Hauptsitz in Essenbach sowie an sechs weiteren Trainingszentren weltweit, welche
auch individuell nach Ihren Vorstellungen geplant werden können, bleiben Sie immer auf dem neuesten
Stand der Dinge und lernen frühzeitig, welche neuen Technologien wichtig sind, was im Trend ist und
wie noch weiter für effizientes Arbeiten in der Lackierkabine gesorgt werden kann.

Im Downloadbereich bieten wir mit unseren Produktkatalogen sowie Flyern, Broschüren und Videos auch
viele andere Möglichkeiten, um sich gezielt über MIPA und das gesamte Produktsortiment zu
informieren.

[Schulungen][57]
[Downloads][58]
[Kontakt][59]

### Karriere

Die Mipa Gruppe ist weltweit mit rund 1700 Beschäftigten tätig. Das Engagement und Wissen aller
Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter ist die Basis für unseren Erfolg. Deshalb steht ein respektvolles
und offenes Miteinander für uns an oberster Stelle.

Ob [Ausbildung][60], [Werkstudententätigkeit][61], [Abschlussarbeit][62] oder [Festanstellung][63] –
MIPA bietet zahlreiche Möglichkeiten für einen heimatnahen Karriereeinstieg.

In this deep dive, we explore the underlying factors that make this topic so critical for the future
of the travel industry. Our research indicates that organizations that adapt early to these changes
will see a significant competitive advantage in the coming decade.

### Key Takeaways
* Strategic alignment with emerging technologies is no longer optional.
* Infrastructure scalability remains the primary bottleneck for global expansion.
* Unified data layers are essential for operational excellence in hospitality.

Our Evolution

## Journey So Far

A chronological roadmap of our strategic milestones, technological breakthroughs, and global
infrastructure expansion.

Common Inquiries

## Frequently Asked Questions

What is MyTravaly?
MyTravaly is a unified global travel infrastructure platform that connects travelers, hospitality
leaders, and creators through intelligent technology, seamless distribution, and automated financial
systems.
How does the platform help hotel owners?
We provide hotel owners with an integrated Property Management System (PMS), global distribution
access via our marketplace, and AI-driven pricing intelligence to optimize occupancy and maximize
revenue.
What is the MT Gateway program?
MT Gateway is a monetization infrastructure designed for travel creators and agents. It provides
access to global inventory with customizable markups and instant automated payouts.
Is MyTravaly available globally?
Yes, MyTravaly operates as a borderless infrastructure, supporting properties and partners in over
190 countries with multi-currency settlement and localized support.
How can I start a partnership with MyTravaly?
You can start by selecting your specific portal (Traveler, Hotelier, Creator, or Investor) or by
reaching out directly through our Connect section below. Our team will guide you through the
onboarding process.
Connect With Us

Whether you are a hospitality leader, a travel creator, or an institutional investor, we are ready
to discuss how MyTravaly can power your growth.

## Privacy Policy – MyTravaly Worldwide Travel Technology Pvt Ltd

**Effective Date: 15-04-2026**

MyTravaly Worldwide Travel Technology Pvt Ltd (“MyTravaly”, “we”, “our”, “us”) respects your privacy
and is committed to protecting your personal data in compliance with applicable laws, including the
General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other international data protection laws.

### 1. Information We Collect

**a. Personal Information**
* Name, email address, phone number
* Billing and payment details
* Identification details (if required for bookings)

**b. Business Information (for hoteliers/partners)**
* Property details (name, address, contact info)
* Bank details for payouts
* Tax and registration details

**c. Usage Data**
* IP address, browser type, device information
* Pages visited, time spent, interactions

**d. Cookies & Tracking Technologies**

We use cookies, pixels, and similar technologies for functionality, analytics, and marketing.

### 2. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)

We process personal data under the following legal bases:
* Contractual necessity (booking, payments, services)
* Legitimate interests (platform improvement, fraud prevention)
* Consent (marketing, cookies tracking)
* Legal obligations (tax, compliance requirements)

### 3. How We Use Your Information

We use collected data to:
* Facilitate hotel bookings and confirmations
* Process payments and payouts
* Provide customer support
* Improve platform performance and features
* Send updates, offers, and notifications (with consent where required)
* Ensure security and prevent fraud

### 4. Sharing of Information

We may share your data with:
* Hotels and service providers (booking fulfillment)
* Payment gateways (transaction processing)
* Analytics & marketing partners (Google, Meta)
* Legal authorities when required

We do not sell personal data.

### 5. International Data Transfers

As a global platform, your data may be transferred outside your country (including the EU/EEA).
We ensure safeguards such as: Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs), Secure infrastructure and
encryption.

### 6. Data Retention

We retain data only as long as necessary for: Service delivery, Legal compliance, Dispute
resolution.

### 7. Your Rights (GDPR & Global Users)

You have the right to:
* Access your personal data
* Rectify inaccurate data
* Erase data (“Right to be forgotten”)
* Restrict or object to processing
* Data portability
* Withdraw consent at any time

To exercise rights: support@mytravaly.com

### 8. Cookies & Tracking Policy

We use the following categories of cookies: Essential Cookies, Analytics Cookies (Google Analytics),
Marketing Cookies (Meta, Google Ads).

### 9. Cookie Consent Mechanism

When you visit our website: You will see a cookie consent banner. You can accept, reject, or
customize preferences. Consent is stored and can be withdrawn anytime.

### 10. Data Security

We implement: Encryption (SSL/TLS), Secure servers and access control, Regular monitoring and
audits.

### 11. Data Protection Officer (DPO)

For GDPR-related queries: Email: support@mytravaly.com
(You may designate a formal DPO as you scale in EU markets)

### 12. Third-Party Links

We are not responsible for external website privacy practices.

### 13. Children’s Privacy

Our services are not intended for individuals under 18.

### 14. Updates to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Changes will be reflected with a revised effective
date.

### 15. Contact Us

MyTravaly Worldwide Travel Technology Pvt Ltd
Email: admin@mytravaly.com
Website: www.mytravaly.com

By using our platform, you agree to this Privacy Policy and consent to our data practices.

Terms & Conditions

* Withdraw consent at any time

audits.

## "As a leading innovative automotive painting company we bring creativity to paint"

Part of the Nippon Paint Group, which was created over 140 years ago, NPAC was established in
February 1971 and is a leading global paint manufacturer that handles in-house all automotive
coatings, from electrodeposition paint (E-coat), primer, and basecoat/clearcoat for the auto body to
paint for plastic bumpers and interior parts. With a diverse and highly passionate workforce of
38,000 within the corporation and 5,800 automotive specialists, we draw on our knowledge of the
overall automotive painting process and our wealth of coating expertise; we have created a system
that maximises the properties of each coat and paint film while creating synergy.

With five sites across Europe and links to our global partners, we are in a strong position to
support the European and global markets around the world. We understand the local needs of our
customers in every community. Each company embraces diversity and operates together, creating a
strong and unified global presence.

[ Our Company ][29]
[ Our Culture ][30]

# Coating Solutions

Steel plate and aluminium materials are widely used in the auto body. The surface is treated with a
chemical conversion coating before the painting process. Several coats are then applied in order…

[ecoat][ecoat]

#### E-coat

The E-coat is an undercoat used for automotive OEMs, developed for anti-corrosion protection and
appearance improvement.

[ More >> ][31]
[primer][primer]

#### Primer

Primer is applied to the E-coat before the basecoat and clearcoat, preparing the E-coat surface for
the finished topcoat result.

[ More >> ][32]
[basecoat][basecoat]

#### Basecoat

The basecoat brings colour to the complete paint system. Common basecoats are solvent-based,
water-based and now primerless.

[ More >> ][33]
[clearcoat][clearcoat]

#### Clearcoat

This is the final layer of the automotive coating. The clearcoat paint gives the car’s body and
plastic parts the final gloss appearance.

[ More >> ][34]
[plastic coatings][plastic coatings]

#### Plastic Coating

NPAC offers a full range of automotive OEM paint coatings for integrated plastic parts, including
Polypropylene and ABS.

[ More >> ][35]
[interior coating][interior coating]

#### Interior Coating

NPAC offers a full range of interior painting solutions for all requirements to ensure the same
high-quality finish that our customers expect.

[ More >> ][36]

## Maximum Performance

We design each coat with the utmost care, taking into account the effect of one on another in the
painting process and ensuring that the final multi-layer paint film achieves maximum performance.

**Paint for plastic parts**

Lightweight plastic is not just used for bumpers. It is also used for other automotive parts in
response to needs, such as reducing vehicle weight and extending design possibilities.

With plastic bumpers, a primer is first applied to improve the adhesion of the paint to the product,
and then basecoat and clearcoat for colour and lustre. We are also designing paints tailored to the
material and use of various components other than bumpers.

[ More >> ][37]
[maximum results][maximum results]
[nippon paint automotive coatings][nippon paint automotive coatings]

## Enhancing Driver Experience

Cars are not only a mode of transportation but also a vital item for enriching our lifestyle. We
seek to enhance the car’s value through paint and paint film and deliver fresh delight to the
driver.

**Solutions for enhancing vehicle value**

One of our major initiatives in this area is the development of Premium Colour products based on
in-house research and our proprietary expertise.

Cars featuring Premium Colour are proving popular for the added value provided by innovative colour
designs, addressing driver preferences, trends, and owner satisfaction.

[ More >> ][38]
[ ][39]

Nippon Paint is a global leader, providing innovative solutions in the paint and coatings industry
for over 140 years.

strong and unified global presence.

# Coating Solutions

Steel plate and aluminium materials are widely used in the auto body. The surface is treated with a
chemical conversion coating before the painting process. Several coats are then applied in order…

[ecoat][ecoat]

#### E-coat

The E-coat is an undercoat used for automotive OEMs, developed for anti-corrosion protection and
appearance improvement.

[ More >> ][31]
[primer][primer]

#### Primer

Primer is applied to the E-coat before the basecoat and clearcoat, preparing the E-coat surface for
the finished topcoat result.

[ More >> ][32]
[basecoat][basecoat]

#### Basecoat

The basecoat brings colour to the complete paint system. Common basecoats are solvent-based,
water-based and now primerless.

[ More >> ][33]
[clearcoat][clearcoat]

#### Clearcoat

This is the final layer of the automotive coating. The clearcoat paint gives the car’s body and
plastic parts the final gloss appearance.

[ More >> ][34]
[plastic coatings][plastic coatings]

#### Plastic Coating

NPAC offers a full range of automotive OEM paint coatings for integrated plastic parts, including
Polypropylene and ABS.

[ More >> ][35]
[interior coating][interior coating]

#### Interior Coating

NPAC offers a full range of interior painting solutions for all requirements to ensure the same
high-quality finish that our customers expect.

[ More >> ][36]

## Maximum Performance

We design each coat with the utmost care, taking into account the effect of one on another in the
painting process and ensuring that the final multi-layer paint film achieves maximum performance.

**Paint for plastic parts**

Lightweight plastic is not just used for bumpers. It is also used for other automotive parts in
response to needs, such as reducing vehicle weight and extending design possibilities.

With plastic bumpers, a primer is first applied to improve the adhesion of the paint to the product,
and then basecoat and clearcoat for colour and lustre. We are also designing paints tailored to the
material and use of various components other than bumpers.

[ More >> ][37]

Cars are not only a mode of transportation but also a vital item for enriching our lifestyle. We
seek to enhance the car’s value through paint and paint film and deliver fresh delight to the
driver.

**Solutions for enhancing vehicle value**

One of our major initiatives in this area is the development of Premium Colour products based on
in-house research and our proprietary expertise.

Cars featuring Premium Colour are proving popular for the added value provided by innovative colour
designs, addressing driver preferences, trends, and owner satisfaction.

February 1971 and is a leading global paint manufacturer that handles in-house all automotive
coatings, from electrodeposition paint (E-coat), primer, and basecoat/clearcoat for the auto body to
paint for plastic bumpers and interior parts. With a diverse and highly passionate workforce of
38,000 within the corporation and 5,800 automotive specialists, we draw on our knowledge of the
overall automotive painting process and our wealth of coating expertise; we have created a system
that maximises the properties of each coat and paint film while creating synergy.

With five sites across Europe and links to our global partners, we are in a strong position to
support the European and global markets around the world. We understand the local needs of our

# EXPERT COATING
# CONSULTING SERVICES

##### SERVICES

 

[More Info][8]

# Superyacht & Industrial Coating Consult & Inspection Services
#  

Get flawless finishes, zero surprises, and bullet‑proof documentation: on yachts, tanks, and
critical infrastructure.

Trusted on high‑stakes assets around the world:

 · 550+ superyacht paint surveys (~$3B asset value)

 · 14M gallons municipal water storage

 · 7M gallons DoD jet fuel tanks

 · 15M sq ft structural steel

 · 7.7M cubic ft wastewater structures.
* Yachts – Paint surveys, QA/hold‑point inspections, full owner’s‑rep QA/QC.
* Infrastructure – Water/Wastewater, Industrial / Commercial, Bridges / Overpasses.
* Defense – Navy, Coast Guard, and other DoD assets.
* Oil & Gas – Refinery Plants, Pipelines, Storage Tanks, Off-Shore Rigs, etc.  

What you get
* Clarity before you spend — objective paint/gelcoat surveys with quantified defects and costed
  options.

* Control during execution — hold‑point QA that prevents rework and change‑order games.

* Cover your downside — defensible reports, test data, and expert testimony when projects go
  sideways.

How engagement works (3 steps)

   1. Assess – 15‑minute triage call + file review.


   2. Scope – Fixed‑fee proposal tied to project value and deliverables.


   3. Execute – Schedule, inspect, report with actionable documentation.

## ABOUT US

Revay Coating Consultants, Inc. (RCCI) is Fort Lauderdale, FL-based consulting and inspection
company that is overflowing with technical knowledge, deep experience, and a genuine passion for all
things related to coatings & corrosion mitigation. RCCI provides various services, such as Quality
Assurance / Control (QA / QC) Coating Inspections, Paints / Coatings / Corrosion based Consulting
Services, Failure Analysis / Root-Cause Investigations, and Expert Witness Services.

 

The founder of RCCI, Mr. David V. Revay, has over fourteen years of experience within the coating /
corrosion industry and he has great enthusiasm for this industry. RCCI's expertise in coatings /
paint systems, corrosion mitigation, and assistance with choosing building materials (preventing /

Products from a huge number of Chinese sellers are displayed on AliExpress. They are sold by both

not meet delivery times or even try to cheat.

# AliExpress Seller Check

Paste the link to the seller's page or to the product from AliExpress.com and we will carry out a
comprehensive analysis. You will receive recommendations for purchasing goods in the selected store.

check

## Why check sellers on AliExpress

Products from a huge number of Chinese sellers are displayed on AliExpress. They are sold by both
large players of the Chinese market with a long history and excellent assortment, as well as small,
start-up companies or individuals. Sometimes it happens that sellers send poor quality products, do
not meet delivery times or even try to cheat.

There are frequent cases of deliberate deception of customers. For example, the tracking number is
incorrect or a low quality craft is sent. In the picture everything "looks like a million dollars",
but in fact a rag of a different color arrives.

As active users of the Aliexpress platform, we decided to take into account all references to
suppliers on the Internet and build a rating with recommendations. We check thousands of items and
manufacturers every day, collect reviews buyers and reports from public sources. The algorithm
analyzes the collected information and gives out important factors, requiring attention before

## Top Questions You May Ask

What are the advantages of laboratory airflow spray dryer compared to centrifugal spray dryer?
Compared with the centrifugal spray dryer, the laboratory airflow spray dryer does not require a
centrifugal turntable for atomization, so the volume is much smaller, and there is no loud noise due
to the high-speed centrifugal rotation of the turntable.
Why can the YC-1800 laboratory low temperature spray dryer achieve an inlet air temperature of
105°C?
YC-1800 laboratory low temperature spray dryer adopts micro-negative pressure design. Under
micro-negative pressure, the water evaporation temperature is lower than 100°C, so it can dry the
material well at an inlet temperature of 105°C.
Why can the laboratory vacuum low temperature spray dryer achieve an inlet air temperature of 60°C?
The laboratory vacuum low-temperature spray dryer uses a vacuum system in the drying chamber. The
moisture is under the vacuum state, the temperature of vaporization is much lower than that under
normal pressure, so it can achieve an inlet temperature of 60 °C
Why is it safe to dry organic solvents in a laboratory organic solvent spray dryer?
To ensure the safety of the experiment, the laboratory organic solvent spray dryer uses nitrogen as
the gas carrier. In the entire spray drying system, the oxygen concentration is always controlled
within the safe value set by the system. Once the oxygen concentration exceeds the set value, the
system will not start or automatically shut down.
Why can a laboratory spray dryer use glass as a drying room?
The laboratory spray dryer can use high borosilicate glass, which can withstand high temperature of
500 °C, to ensure that the glass will not break due to heat when the spray dryer is working, and to
ensure that the experiment process can be observed at the same time.
Can organic solvent spray dryer use air for drying aqueous solutions?
Yes, when drying the aqueous solution, you can turn off the oxygen monitoring system and the
nitrogen circulation system, so that you can directly use air as a heat source to save nitrogen.
What is the process of the laboratory organic solvent spray dryer?
Both atomization and hot air use inert gas, such as nitrogen. After the material is atomized into
small droplets, it encounters hot nitrogen and dries instantly. The dried material is collected with
hot air under the action of the cyclone separator in the bottle. Hot nitrogen, organic solvent vapor
 and a small amount of powder that has not been collected enter the nitrogen circulation system, the
powder is first recovered, and then the exhaust gas enters the condensation system, the organic
solvent vapor is condensed and recovered, and the cleaned nitrogen enters the next cycle .
What is the particle size of the material after drying in laboratory airflow spray dryer ?
The particle size of the material after drying in laboratory airflow spray dryer is generally 1-25
microns. After Shanghai Pilotech improved the equipment manufacturing process, the maximum particle
size of some models can reach 100 microns.
