## Top Questions You May Ask

What are the advantages of laboratory airflow spray dryer compared to centrifugal spray dryer?
Compared with the centrifugal spray dryer, the laboratory airflow spray dryer does not require a
centrifugal turntable for atomization, so the volume is much smaller, and there is no loud noise due
to the high-speed centrifugal rotation of the turntable.
Why can the YC-1800 laboratory low temperature spray dryer achieve an inlet air temperature of
105°C?
YC-1800 laboratory low temperature spray dryer adopts micro-negative pressure design. Under
micro-negative pressure, the water evaporation temperature is lower than 100°C, so it can dry the
material well at an inlet temperature of 105°C.
Why can the laboratory vacuum low temperature spray dryer achieve an inlet air temperature of 60°C?
The laboratory vacuum low-temperature spray dryer uses a vacuum system in the drying chamber. The
moisture is under the vacuum state, the temperature of vaporization is much lower than that under
normal pressure, so it can achieve an inlet temperature of 60 °C
Why is it safe to dry organic solvents in a laboratory organic solvent spray dryer?
To ensure the safety of the experiment, the laboratory organic solvent spray dryer uses nitrogen as
the gas carrier. In the entire spray drying system, the oxygen concentration is always controlled
within the safe value set by the system. Once the oxygen concentration exceeds the set value, the
system will not start or automatically shut down.
Why can a laboratory spray dryer use glass as a drying room?
The laboratory spray dryer can use high borosilicate glass, which can withstand high temperature of
500 °C, to ensure that the glass will not break due to heat when the spray dryer is working, and to
ensure that the experiment process can be observed at the same time.
Can organic solvent spray dryer use air for drying aqueous solutions?
Yes, when drying the aqueous solution, you can turn off the oxygen monitoring system and the
nitrogen circulation system, so that you can directly use air as a heat source to save nitrogen.
What is the process of the laboratory organic solvent spray dryer?
Both atomization and hot air use inert gas, such as nitrogen. After the material is atomized into
small droplets, it encounters hot nitrogen and dries instantly. The dried material is collected with
hot air under the action of the cyclone separator in the bottle. Hot nitrogen, organic solvent vapor
 and a small amount of powder that has not been collected enter the nitrogen circulation system, the
powder is first recovered, and then the exhaust gas enters the condensation system, the organic
solvent vapor is condensed and recovered, and the cleaned nitrogen enters the next cycle .
What is the particle size of the material after drying in laboratory airflow spray dryer ?
The particle size of the material after drying in laboratory airflow spray dryer is generally 1-25
microns. After Shanghai Pilotech improved the equipment manufacturing process, the maximum particle
size of some models can reach 100 microns.

Keyword

# Protective.
# Emotive.
# Demand both.

From automotive and aerospace to coil and specialty, we engineer coatings and surface solutions that
protect and inspire.

[ About us ][60]
[ What we do ][61]
Image
[People on tank]

## Over 130 years of expertise. A new beginning.

We are Surventis - formerly known as BASF Coatings - a global leader in automotive coatings and
surface treatment. Following the agreement between BASF and Carlyle, we have become an independent,
standalone company: a new identity, built on continuity.

Our new chapter builds on the foundations that have made us strong: deep technical expertise,
long-standing customer relationships, trusted heritage brands, and a culture shaped over more than
130 years. As an independent company, we now move with greater entrepreneurial freedom, faster
decision-making and agility, backed by Carlyle's global network and commitment to our growth.

[ Press Release ][62]

## What defines us

Our intelligent coatings help customers shine in their markets. We anticipate global trends and
identify opportunities that shape the future of industries. We meet the highest technical and
quality demands in an aesthetically pleasing, environmentally friendly way, combining design with
functionality. Our work in research, production and service is reliable worldwide.

### Driven by passion and science

Built on BASF's heritage with a more entrepreneurial future, we foster an inspiring exchange across
diverse perspectives.

[ Careers ][64]

### Merging science and beauty

Close collaboration, global presence, expertise and innovation are the pillars of our commercial
success.

[ About us ][65]

### Reliable worldwide

Around 10,000 employees at our more than 70 sites of Surventis are ready to serve, wherever you are
located.

[ Locations ][66]
Image
[Purple automotive coating]

## What we do

We engineer coatings and surface solutions, from treatment to refinish, across automotive and many
other industries. Working with us means going further to solve even your most challenging needs.
[
Image
[back 3/4 view of a white car with a sunset in the background] ][67]

### Automotive

Our solutions support a broad range of vehicle categories and powertrain concepts, helping
manufacturers, suppliers, body builders and bodyshops create the surfaces that keep the automotive
world moving.
[Learn more][68]
[
Image
[airplane flying view from inside window of aircraft, flying above the clouds during sunset] ][69]

### Aerospace

With decades of aerospace experience and a broad portfolio of OEM approved technologies, we support
a wide range of aircraft types and applications.
[Learn more][70]
[
Image
[detail of steel coils in warehouse] ][71]

### Coil

We support the coil industry with surface treatment and advanced application technologies that
prepare and protect metal before it is shaped and coated.
[Learn more][72]
[
Image
[motorcycles parked in row in various colors] ][73]

### Specialty

From a perfectly smooth piano finish to precise optical components and durable motorcycle surfaces,
we help each surface perform as intended in its own context.
[Learn more][74]

From the world's most advanced color expertise to award-winning sustainable innovation, these are

### Refinity® – a seamless digital experience for bodyshops

Our cloud-based platform brings together a full suite of digital solutions for automotive refinish,
helping body shops worldwide work faster, more sustainably and with the most advanced digital color
experience available.
[Discover Refinity®][76]
[
Image
[Tesseract blue] ][77]

### Automotive Color Trends – DRIVING THE PROXY

Each year our designers shape the colors of tomorrow's vehicles. Our latest collection draws on
design, nature and technology, with sustainable materials and innovations like multi-color pigments
and liquid-metal surfaces.
[Explore the collection][78]
[
Image
[Automotive color display] ][79]

### The world's largest color databases

Decades of color expertise, captured in one of the world's largest databases. It lets us match and
reproduce virtually any shade with precision, whether designing tomorrow's vehicles or restoring
today's.
[Our color expertise][80]
[
Image
[R-M expert] ][81]

### Trusted heritage brands

Behind Surventis stands a portfolio of brands the industry has relied on for generations. Glasurit®,
with over 130 years of refinish expertise, and R-M®, with more than a century of color leadership,
are recognized by bodyshops and manufacturers worldwide, alongside specialist brands like baslac®
and Norbin®. These names carry a legacy of quality that continues into our new chapter.
[Meet our brands][82]

## Latest News

### [ Surventis launches as an independent global leader in automotive coatings and surface
### treatment ][84]

MUENSTER, Germany, July 1, 2026. Surventis, formerly BASF Coatings, today launched as an independent
company, completing its carve-out from BASF. With around €3.9 billion in annual sales and around
10,700 employees, Surventis is one of the world’s leading suppliers of automotive coatings and
surface treatment solutions. The business is majority-owned by funds managed by global investment
firm Carlyle (NASDAQ: CG) in partnership with Qatar Investment Authority. BASF holds a 40% stake in
Surventis.
Jul 1, 2026
[[Image of the executive committee of Surventis] ][85]
New
Corporate

### [ BASF Coatings names Executive Committee to lead and drive success as a standalone company
### ][86]

MUENSTER, Germany, June 25, 2026. BASF Coatings today named the leadership team that will run the
business as an independent company from July 1, 2026, after the closing of the transaction. The new
structure brings together leaders who have built the coatings business over many years and senior
executives with proven records in finance, digital and transformation. The Executive Committee will
be led by incoming Chief Executive Officer Jens Luehring.
Jun 26, 2026

The sale of BASF’s Brazilian decorative paints business to Sherwin-Williams was completed on October
1, 2025, following the approval of the transaction by the relevant Brazilian competition authority
at the end of August 2025. On a cash and debt-free basis, the purchase price amounted to $1.15
billion.

## What defines us

Our intelligent coatings help customers shine in their markets. We anticipate global trends and
identify opportunities that shape the future of industries. We meet the highest technical and
quality demands in an aesthetically pleasing, environmentally friendly way, combining design with
functionality. Our work in research, production and service is reliable worldwide.

### Driven by passion and science

Built on BASF's heritage with a more entrepreneurial future, we foster an inspiring exchange across
diverse perspectives.

[ Careers ][64]

### Merging science and beauty

Close collaboration, global presence, expertise and innovation are the pillars of our commercial
success.

[ About us ][65]

### Reliable worldwide

Around 10,000 employees at our more than 70 sites of Surventis are ready to serve, wherever you are
located.

[ Locations ][66]
Image
[Purple automotive coating]

## What we do

We engineer coatings and surface solutions, from treatment to refinish, across automotive and many
other industries. Working with us means going further to solve even your most challenging needs.
[
Image
[back 3/4 view of a white car with a sunset in the background] ][67]

### Automotive

Our solutions support a broad range of vehicle categories and powertrain concepts, helping
manufacturers, suppliers, body builders and bodyshops create the surfaces that keep the automotive
world moving.
[Learn more][68]
[
Image
[airplane flying view from inside window of aircraft, flying above the clouds during sunset] ][69]

### Aerospace

With decades of aerospace experience and a broad portfolio of OEM approved technologies, we support
a wide range of aircraft types and applications.
[Learn more][70]
[
Image
[detail of steel coils in warehouse] ][71]

### Coil

We support the coil industry with surface treatment and advanced application technologies that
prepare and protect metal before it is shaped and coated.
[Learn more][72]
[
Image
[motorcycles parked in row in various colors] ][73]

### Specialty

From a perfectly smooth piano finish to precise optical components and durable motorcycle surfaces,
we help each surface perform as intended in its own context.
[Learn more][74]
Image

## What sets us apart

From the world's most advanced color expertise to award-winning sustainable innovation, these are
some of the capabilities that make us a partner unlike any other.

[
Image
[Refinity app on tablet] ][75]

### Refinity® – a seamless digital experience for bodyshops

Our cloud-based platform brings together a full suite of digital solutions for automotive refinish,
helping body shops worldwide work faster, more sustainably and with the most advanced digital color
experience available.
[Discover Refinity®][76]
[
Image
[Tesseract blue] ][77]

### Automotive Color Trends – DRIVING THE PROXY

Each year our designers shape the colors of tomorrow's vehicles. Our latest collection draws on
design, nature and technology, with sustainable materials and innovations like multi-color pigments
and liquid-metal surfaces.
[Explore the collection][78]
[
Image
[Automotive color display] ][79]

### The world's largest color databases

Decades of color expertise, captured in one of the world's largest databases. It lets us match and
reproduce virtually any shade with precision, whether designing tomorrow's vehicles or restoring
today's.
[Our color expertise][80]
[
Image
[R-M expert] ][81]

### Trusted heritage brands

Behind Surventis stands a portfolio of brands the industry has relied on for generations. Glasurit®,
with over 130 years of refinish expertise, and R-M®, with more than a century of color leadership,
are recognized by bodyshops and manufacturers worldwide, alongside specialist brands like baslac®
and Norbin®. These names carry a legacy of quality that continues into our new chapter.
[Meet our brands][82]

### [ Surventis launches as an independent global leader in automotive coatings and surface
### treatment ][84]

MUENSTER, Germany, July 1, 2026. Surventis, formerly BASF Coatings, today launched as an independent
company, completing its carve-out from BASF. With around €3.9 billion in annual sales and around
10,700 employees, Surventis is one of the world’s leading suppliers of automotive coatings and
surface treatment solutions. The business is majority-owned by funds managed by global investment
firm Carlyle (NASDAQ: CG) in partnership with Qatar Investment Authority. BASF holds a 40% stake in
Surventis.
Jul 1, 2026

  active drug layering solutions.
* #### What Type of Spray Gun Comes With Your Machines?
  
  All of our tablet coating machines are equipped with the patented [Thomas Spray Bar.][52] Designed

  delivery rate, >5% gun to gun spray rate differential, and rapid disassembly and cleaning.

  include components recommended to be kept onsite to minimize downtime in the event of a component
  failure.

  active drug layering solutions.
* #### What Type of Spray Gun Comes With Your Machines?
  
  All of our tablet coating machines are equipped with the patented [Thomas Spray Bar.][52] Designed
  with GMP considerations in mind, our system is fully integrated to offer accurate solution
  delivery rate, >5% gun to gun spray rate differential, and rapid disassembly and cleaning.

## XPEL Protects Nearly Every Surface Under the Sun (and Storm Clouds)

## Paint Protection Film

Self-care, for your car. XPEL’s self-healing paint protection film is designed to keep your vehicle
looking brand new by protecting against rock chips, scratches, and scuffs.

## Automotive Window Tint

Maximize style and comfort with superior heat rejection and UV protection without sacrificing
outbound visibility.

## Windshield Protection Film

Shield your windshield. Get unmatched durability and UV protection with the ultimate defense against
chips, cracks, and road hazards.

## Automotive Ceramic Coating

Bring out the best in your ride. FUSION PLUS enhances your car’s color and makes cleaning a total
breeze thanks to its hydrophobic properties.

## Interior Protection Film

Keep that showroom shine. Fine scratches, swirls, and blemishes are no match for our interior
solutions.
